svg.title: AgentTPACK multi-agent TPACK lesson-planning architecture
svg.desc: Every layer writes to the interaction logs on the right, under one trace id per lesson. Layer 0: the teacher brief from the web wizard, the NCERT Class 7 vector database and the content policy. Input guardrails in order: well-formed request, keyword safety filter, consistency, retrieval of the top 4 passages, relevance threshold, and a Gemini input screen against the content policy; any failure returns HTTP 422 to the wizard. A rule-based context layer prepares each agent's inputs. Layer 1: PK, CK and TK foundational agents, each seeing only its own domain. Layer 2: PCK combines CK and PK, TPK combines PK and TK, TCK combines CK and TK, each recording trade-offs. Layer 3: the TPACK integrator turns all six outputs and the passages into a schema-checked lesson plan, a Gemini output screen reviews it (rewrite once, then remove flagged items), code-based output checks clean it, and the final lesson plan is produced. Stage 2: the materials agent writes handouts and a quiz, which are screened the same way. The teacher receives the plan, handouts and quiz, can open cited passages, regenerate with missing details, or print a teacher pack.
svg.text: NCERT Science Class 7 · 7 TPACK agents + 2 Gemini screening agents · every lesson grounded in cited textbook passages
